data.gist: Immunodeficient rats had DMM surgery and received intra-articular injections of ECM-retaining micronized bone marrow, BMAC, or PBS (100 µL each) four weeks later, with no adverse local reactions.
data.plain: To test human bone marrow preparations in vivo, knee osteoarthritis was induced surgically (destabilization of the medial meniscus) in rats lacking an immune system so human cells would not be rejected. Four weeks later, equal volumes of the micronized bone marrow product, BMAC, or saline were injected into the joint; no infections or local reactions occurred.
